card.name: Section numbers in warning lists
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit or space starting a section reference like (5.2) or (5.3) in a boxed warnings summary. Also fires on a few mid-term pieces such as dementia-related, sleep, and dapagliflozin.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The number or gap opening a cross-reference such as 5.2 or 5.3 after a warning item.

modes.label: Inside compound medical terms
modes.description: A hyphenated or mid-term piece within a longer clinical phrase or drug name.
modes.example: patients with dementia<<-related>> psychosis without agitation

card.plain: It marks the spot where a numbered warning section reference or a compound term continues.
